notes.title: Mystic Rest Stop Update 1.0.5 Available!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! The new update 1.0.5 for Mystic Rest Stop is now available. In this version, I’ve added several improvements based on your feedback. Here’s a summary of the new features:

New Features and Improvements

New mysterious section in the menu
A new option has been added to the menu... but I can't tell you much yet. All I’ll say is stay tuned.

Main menu improvement
Some small adjustments have been made to improve the visual and functional experience of the main menu.

Translation fix
Some players reported issues when changing the language in the game. This has been fixed, and now you can also change the language directly from the pause menu.

Auto-save
A highly requested feature by the community! The game will now automatically save progress at each level, allowing you to continue from where you left off.

Improved interaction with the PC
Previously, the computer would activate automatically when getting close, which caused some bugs and feedback. Now you’ll need to press the "C" key near the PC to interact with it.

General fixes
Bug fixes have been made on the map, audio, and other aspects of the game to improve the overall experience.

📢 As always, I’ll be paying attention to your feedback. If you encounter any issues or have suggestions, let me know! Thanks for your patience and support, and I hope you enjoy this new version.

notes.title: Game Update + Special Announcement
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! I hope you're all doing well.

I’m here to give you an update on the game. I'm currently working on a new update to improve the experience and make it more enjoyable for you. I'm reading all your comments and trying to fix any issues you report. If I haven’t addressed a particular problem yet, it’s possible I haven’t seen your message.

Remember, you can reach out through our Discord channel for any questions, and you can also leave your feedback and issues on the Steam discussion forum.

This update will focus on fixing the following issues:
✅ PC-related bug affecting some players.
✅ Translation issue, as some users have reported that the game isn’t translating correctly (I’m currently investigating the cause).
✅ Improvements to vehicle handling and other fixes that I’ll share more details about soon.

The update is expected to be released by the end of this month or early April.

I also have some exciting news! 🎉 I’m finishing the development of a new psychological horror game called "Online Records: Unknown Seller"(https://store.steampowered.com/app/3565030/Online_Records_Unknown_Seller/?curator_clanid=4777282), which you can now add to your Steam wishlist. It will be completely free and will be released later on. I think you're going to love it!

Thank you for your patience and support. I apologize if I haven’t been able to read or respond to all comments. Wishing you all the best, and stay tuned for more updates!

notes.title: Important Announcement: Report Bugs and Help Improve the Game
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! I hope you’re doing great.

I want to thank you for taking the time to play and share your thoughts about my game. I’m writing this announcement because I’ve noticed some negative comments in the reviews due to game bugs. I understand that encountering a bug can be frustrating for your gaming experience, and I want to assure you that my priority is to improve the game and resolve any issues as quickly as possible.

I don’t criticize anyone for leaving negative reviews, but I’d like to kindly ask that, before doing so (or even afterward), you consider reaching out to me to report the bugs. Here are two ways you can do that:
1 Steam Forum: [Suggestions/Bug] 
2 Discord Server: Join here. https://discord.com/invite/Qj2QuepfjU

In these spaces, you can provide detailed descriptions of the bugs and even attach photos or videos so I can identify and fix them as quickly as possible.

This is my first game developed solo, and I’m putting all my effort into making it the best it can be. Your feedback and bug reports are essential to improving the game and offering you a more satisfying experience.

Thank you from the bottom of my heart for your attention, support, and for helping me grow as a developer! I wish you an amazing day and a fantastic gaming experience.

notes.title: Thank you for all the support and news about upcoming updates!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

I want to deeply thank you for all the support I’ve received for the game. I’ve received amazing feedback through Steam, Twitter, and YouTube, and I’m honestly so excited about the impact it’s had. I owe all of this to you, and I want to express my sincere gratitude for all the kind words and enthusiasm you’ve shared with me.

I’m currently working on updates to fix the issues that have been reported to me, with the goal of improving the gaming experience for everyone. I apologize if at any point that experience has been affected by a bug. Please remember you can report any issues you find in the bug section on Steam or Discord. This really helps me a lot in identifying and fixing problems quickly.

Additionally, I want you to know that I’m planning future updates to continue improving the game and adding some enhancements that will make the experience even better.  

Once again, thank you so much for all your support. I hope you’re enjoying the game to the fullest and that you continue to join me on this journey. See you in the next update!

Thank you from the bottom of my heart! ❤️
